documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27 with revenue from operations reaching INR 121 crores, marking a 60% year-on-year growth. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 18 crores with a margin of 14.9%, while Profit After Tax was INR 9 crores translating to a 7.5% PAT margin. Management highlighted upcoming retail store launches in Surat and Rajkot around Q2 and Q3, and noted a strategic focus towards expanding retail presence and gradually incorporating Gold Metal Loans (GML) for inventory hedging. The company maintains an optimistic demand outlook supported by robust order books and successful trade show participation. RBZ Jewellers Ltd.

guidance.claim: The company reported revenue growth for the quarter in line with the guidance shared in the previous period.
guidance.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the July and August order kitty are full following successful showcase of designs at IIJS.
demand_outlook.quote: There has been a good, successful appreciation of designs even from corporate end, because of which the July, August order kitty are full.

demand_outlook.claim: The management expects the demand side to be good and promising for Quarter 2.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that occasion wear demand is more resilient compared to daily wear.
demand_outlook.quote: And we are in a segment wherein the demand is more resilient, and hence I think it's the right proposition to be in this segment and grow in a profitable gold segment that is an antique category.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the IIJS trade show was very warm, encouraging, and yielded good order backing.
demand_outlook.quote: So IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company continues to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that April has been very good in terms of business performance.
demand_outlook.quote: Now how has been April? April has been very good.

capex_expansion.claim: Surat store is slated for launch in Quarter 2, and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.

capex_expansion.claim: Maninagar and Gandhinagar stores will both be launched in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores have a carpet area of around 10,000 square feet while mid-format stores are 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company targets maximum utilization of its existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by the second quarter of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: A typical large format store in Surat and Rajkot will need an inventory of somewhere around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: A typical large format store will need an inventory of somewhere around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 18 crores with EBITDA margins at 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 9 crores translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Average gold rate remained stagnant leading to negligible inventory gains in the system for Q1.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now.

margins_costs.claim: For the full financial year 2026, EBITDA increased by 43% to INR92 crores with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44%.
margins_costs.quote: For the financial year 2026, revenue from operations stood at INR637 crores, reflecting the growth of 20% year-on-year. EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: Factory capacity utilization runs around 50% on an overall basis.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: During core season times like July, August, and September, capacity utilization generally goes to 75% - 85% or higher.
orders_capacity.quote: In the season times, currently as of now, our capacity utilization generally goes at 70%, 80% minimum, 75%, 85% sometimes, depending on which days are all, sometimes it is near to 90% or so.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the current capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a sanctioned debt of around INR 300 crores which is sufficient for the four stores coming up this financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that by the end of this financial year the debt-to-equity ratio will still remain below 1:1 at around 0.8.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has started using GML in a small way this quarter and plans to completely churn inventory into hedged status over three years.
capital_allocation.quote: We have already started using GML in this quarter, a little bit, but as and when the quarter passes we want to completely churn over the whole inventory to go hedged. But that will take three year of time that I, as you have said.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that inventory expansion for new stores will be funded through a mix of debt raise, inventory transfer, and profit gains without equity dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: No. I think the raise of debt plus inventory transfer, plus the profit gain would actually suffice it.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements involve known or unknown risks, uncertainties and other factors.
risks_headwinds.quote: Before we proceed with the call, let me remind you that the discussion may contain forward-looking statements that may involve known or unknown risks, uncertainties and other factors.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that recent restrictions regarding customs duty and advanced authorization on gold imports are immediate events, and the company is taking time to understand actual ground-level impacts.
risks_headwinds.quote: So see, these are very immediate events or it has just been a few days that these all things are happening. And generally, we would take some time, let's say, a week or 2, in fact, a little bit more to understand what -- how the market and the consumers are reacting.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets the B2B to B2C mix to reach around 50-50 in a year or two.
management_commitments.quote: For revenue mix, we see that job work percentage right now in Quarter 1 stands at 54% and, the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two

management_commitments.claim: Management targets the long-term revenue mix to be 75% retail and 25% B2B.
management_commitments.quote: and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects capex break-even for the new stores to be achieved in a year or less.
management_commitments.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the corporate sales mix in 18 caratage to reach at least 20% by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have introduced this since December, our sales mix in corporate, before it was 100% 22 carat, I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to gear up the debt-to-equity ratio to 1.5 or 2:1 over a period of time.
management_commitments.quote: Over the period of time we are wanting to gear up this to 1.5 or 2:1 debt equity ratio, wherein major leverage will be through Gold Metal Loan

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the target of maximum utilization of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
